weather.blurb: Back to triple digits. Do the outdoor errands before lunch.

air.blurb: Fine for most of us. If your lungs are touchy, take it a little easy.

lake.blurb: The lake is all but full, though it gave back a little ground this week.

pollen.blurb: Ragweed and grasses are up. Allergy folks, take the pill before it takes you.

grid.blurb: A busy grid this afternoon, but ERCOT expects enough to go around.

sun.blurb: Just under 13 hours of daylight, and the porch is bearable again after dark.
